{{Top|leg}}
A '''patrol squadron''' was a small formation of the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]]. A patrol squadron under the command of [[Firmus Piett/Legends|Firmus Piett]] operated in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Piett's patrol squadron had an impressive record of arrests and suppressions, making the [[Sector/Legends|sector]] one of the most secure in the Outer Rim.<ref name="SWTSE">''[[Star Wars Trilogy Sourcebook, Special Edition]]''</ref>
